full_page.content:
1935, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 16 Cont. July Janet Murphy - 26 - heart trouble fears operation ... Examination To-M. Anthony Clancy - 24 - cancer of Stomach - operated - bad. ... Mitchell Michael - 13 - paralysed since 2 yrs. old. Michael Hayes - 20 - has T.B. of Spine for 2 yrs. Home now & well. Josephine Bono - 45 - cataract operation feared - no Easter.
Edw'd Collins - 12 Mrs. O'Hagan - 72 - cancer
Page 17 July 19 20
Mrs. Nellie O'Leary - 55 - mental in Receiving Hosp.
Andr. Tagarel - 43 - leakage of heart - sorosis of liver etc etc.
Agnes Bowman - 28 -(nerveous breakdown) Was teaching at a convent, now three yrs. since trouble began ..... in Ypsilanti.
Leo DeVriendt - 25 - '6 - Stomach trouble & rectum cancer. Doubting about going to Montreal - promise percentage of trip.
24 Wm. Ladouceur - 45 - position outside because of health - Father of seven Children all depending upon him.
Mrs. M. O'Hare - 39 - nerveous - no sleep.
Mrs. Geo. Greig - 76 - Eyes & Ears. Mrs. M. O'Hare - 39 - Eyes & Ear - no sleep - nerveous
Cecelia - 21 - girl - mental trouble
= 27 Phil. Sullivan - husband & Father struggling for 6 yrs to live, etc. Came last Thursday a week, discouraged. Advised to promise the Poor Souls a small percentage of profits ... Comes To-day to enroll them for $5.00 ... 10% - Besides, outlook is decidedly brighter.
Page 18 July Page 19 July 26 11
